title: 第20章 升级后的天珠确实好使

第20章 升级后的天珠确实好使-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

照样一大早顾承安就醒了。

新床垫的舒适性确实比之前的棕垫好，舒坦。

他利索地起床洗漱，煎了两个鸡蛋，配上一杯热奶。

明天的机票已经订好了，下午两点半的航班，经济舱，四百多。

这回没纠结。

今天一整天都是自由时间，正好拿来测试升级后的天珠。

说白了就是遛弯儿采数据，只不过现在遛弯儿有了靶向性。

出门前他特意检查了一遍手机设置。

天珠APP的关键词提醒已经开着，录入的词条有很多个，从通缉犯、贩毒到诈骗等等一应俱全。

“来吧。”他冲手机屏幕暗自嘀咕了一句，“让我看看一千五百正义值花得有多值。”

锁好门，下楼，新电驴安静地停在车棚里。

骑上去，取出头盔带上，拧了下油门，提速丝滑。

先出小区溜达一圈。

小区门口左拐不到二百米，路边有一排底商。

粮油店、水果摊、快递驿站……。

最靠里的位置是一家烟酒商行，门面不是很大，招牌上写着鑫隆烟酒。

里面敞亮，∏型玻璃柜台里摆摆满了烟，后面是一排摆满了酒的立柜，门口还立了俩冰柜，摆满了各种饮料。

顾承安原本只是路过，扫了一眼，心想这么热的天，进去买瓶水带着吧。

他把车停在门口，走进店里。

柜台后面坐着个中年男人，五十来岁，花白短发，穿着深蓝色POlO衫，面相偏精明，正低头刷短视频。

听那声音，脑海中不自觉的就出现了一个美女正在卖力扭着纤细腰姿的画面。

甩了甩头，把这种奇奇怪怪的想法掐掉。

都怪这老板，大白天的看些啥玩意。

顾承安走到冰柜前拉开门，拿了一瓶农夫矿泉水。

他刚转身走向柜台准备扫码付钱，裤兜里的手机突然震动了一下。

心里一动。

顾承安面上没有任何变化，掏出手机扫码。

“嘀——”

“老板，付了啊。”他晃了晃手机。

“嗯。”老板头抬头回应了声，继续低头看视频。

顾承安转身走到门口附近，背对柜台，看了一眼天珠APP的提醒。

点开APP。

一条信息被标红置顶：

【姓名：周国胜。】

【身份证号：440911……15】

【手机号码：135*****482】

Gu Chengan woke up early in the morning.

The comfort of the new mattress is indeed better and more comfortable than the previous brown mattress.

He got up neatly, washed up, fried two eggs, and served them with a cup of hot milk.

The air tickets for tomorrow have been booked. The flight at 2:30 pm, economy class, costs more than 400.

No worries this time.

I have free time all day today, just in time to test the upgraded Dzi beads.

To put it bluntly, it's just that Waner collects data, but now Lawaner has a targeted nature.

Before going out, he checked the settings on his phone.

The Tianzhu APP's keyword reminder has been turned on, and there are many entered entries, ranging from wanted criminals, drug trafficking to fraud, etc.

“Come on,” he muttered to his phone screen, “let me see how much justice is worth fifteen hundred dollars.”

Lock the door and go downstairs. The new eDonkey parked quietly in the carport.

I got on the bike, took out the helmet strap, turned on the accelerator, and the speed increased smoothly.

First, take a walk around the neighborhood.

Less than 200 meters away from the entrance of the community, turn left and there is a row of low-end shops on the roadside.

Grain and oil stores, fruit stalls, express delivery stations...

The innermost location is a tobacco and alcohol store. The storefront is not very big, and the signboard reads Xinlong Tobacco and Liquor.

The interior is bright and bright, with a ∏-shaped glass counter filled with cigarettes. Behind it is a row of standing cabinets filled with wine. There are also two refrigerators at the door, filled with various drinks.

Gu Chengan was just passing by and glanced at it, thinking that it was such a hot day to go in and buy a bottle of water to take with him.

He parked the car at the door and walked into the store.

There is a middle-aged man sitting behind the counter, in his fifties, with short gray hair, wearing a dark blue Polo shirt, with a shrewd face, and he is browsing short videos with his head down.

Listening to that voice, a picture of a beautiful woman twisting her slender waist appeared in my mind unconsciously.

He shook his head to get rid of this strange thought.

It's all the boss's fault for watching something in broad daylight.

Gu Chengan walked to the freezer, opened the door, and took a bottle of farmer's mineral water.

As soon as he turned around and walked to the counter to scan the QR code to pay, his phone in his trouser pocket suddenly vibrated.

My heart moved.

There was no change on Gu Chengan's face, so he took out his mobile phone and scanned the QR code.

"Beep——"

"Boss, pay it." He shook his phone.

"Yeah." The boss raised his head and responded, continuing to look down at the video.

Gu Chengan turned around and walked near the door, turned his back to the counter, and glanced at the reminder on the Dzi Bead APP.

Click on the APP.

A piece of information is highlighted in red:

[Name: Zhou Guosheng.】

[ID number: 440911……15]

【Mobile phone number: 135*****482】
